Java Programming
(Common to CSE & IT)

Time: 3 Hours Answer ALL Questions Max. Marks: 70
Part-A (10 x 2 = 20 Marks)
Stem of the Question
Explain the usage of ‘this’ keyword.
Discuss about binary, unary, and ternary operators.
Explain about the importance of extends and implement keywords.
How to create and use a package in Java program?
Explain Enumerations in Java.
Define inter-thread communication?
Explain about Scanner with an example.
Define ArrayList with syntax.
Give a note on layouts in AWT.
Explain in brief about Flow Layout.

Part-B (5 x 10 = 50 Marks)
Stem of the Question

What is Polymorphism. Explain runtime polymorphism in detail.
Explain about constructor overloading.

OR
Give a brief note on operators in java.
Explain various Access specifiers supported by Java with an example.
What is the importance of Exception Handling in Java? Define and
distinguish between checked and unchecked exceptions.
Explain Packages and Interfaces with a suitable program.

OR
Write a java program which illustrates try, catch, throw, throws and
finally keywords.
Write a Java program to find the area and perimeter of square and circle
using interface.
Differentiate between thread and process? How is a thread created?
Discuss.
What is a stream? What is the difference between byte streams and
character streams? How are they used to capture input from the user?

OR
How to set priorities for threads? Build an example.
Explain in detail about different stream classes.
What is difference between ArrayList and LinkedList in collection
framework? Explain.
What are common algorithms implemented in Collections Framework?

OR
What is the difference between Iterator and Listlterator?
Explain how HashMap works in Java with an example.
Explain the concept of Applet-to-Applet communication with suitable
program.
What is the significance of Layout managers? Discuss briefly various
layout managers.

OR
Write about different event classes.
What are the limitations of AWT?
